name: 2018 livery (pixel tail)
description: White fuselage; 'volaris' in large navy lower case over the forward windows and 'volaris.com' small over the rear windows; the fin near-black with a cross of square 'pixels' round a white centre: magenta and pink on the left, greens on the right, blues above; magenta engines with a white star; navy winglets.

logos.description: Volaris's pixel cross: square pixels in a plus round a white centre, magenta and pink to the left, light green and green to the right, blues above, magenta below, with two dark-grey shade pixels (left of the magenta, under the foot), on the near-black fin. The same picture on both sides (not flipped), so on the right the magenta is toward the trailing edge.
A small white four-pointed sparkle on the magenta cowling.
A small Mexican flag behind the forward door, ahead of the title.

titles.style: Volaris's wordmark: heavy rounded geometric lower case in navy, large, over the forward windows.
The web address in small lower case above the rear windows.

notes: Drawn from XA-VSK (Sept 2025, from below); the pixel cross was redrawn 2026-11-27 from XA-VUT (side-on, right side) and checked on XA-VLW (left): 15 pixels in a plus, the same picture on both sides (not flipped). Year of the scheme's introduction not confirmed here, so 'from' is left out. Specials (e.g. the '20 años' A321neo XA-XXV, 2026) aren't this scheme. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on XA-VSK, measured by its windows (the photo is from ahead and below, so a straight scale along the fuselage doesn't hold): 'volaris' starts about 1.1 m aft of the forward door's middle (x 0.139; it had been drawn 1.4 m further aft) and spans 19 window pitches (10.2 m, length 0.23); baseline about 0.75 m under the windows' middle, the l's top 0.77 m over it (y -0.023, height 0.51), lowercase 0.79 of the l. 'volaris.com' spans 4.8 m (0.108); its start is left as drawn. Volaris's commonest type is the A320neo; this was measured on the A321neo, where the title sits the same distance behind the door.
history: Replaces Skyarium v1's approximate standard (a few colors from memory).
